screen.title: Choose Home
screen.description: Choose the PetGravity home that contains the water fountain.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Choose a login method for the same account and home.

reconfigure.title: Update login
reconfigure.description: Choose a login method for the same account and home.

token.title: Sign in with token
token.description: Paste the token from a PetGravity app request header.

phone.title: Send a login code
phone.description: Enter your mainland China mobile number. Submitting sends one SMS. You can include +86.

sms_code.title: Enter the SMS code
sms_code.description: Enter the six-digit code. To resend after 60 seconds, select Resend code and submit. Only the resulting token is saved.

login_complete.title: Retrieve your devices
login_complete.description: Login succeeded. Submit to retry retrieving your devices with the issued token.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected by PetGravity.
error.invalid_token: The token does not look like a JWT.
error.no_water_fountain: No PetGravity water fountain was found on this account.
error.screen_not_found: The selected home was not found for this token.
error.invalid_phone: Enter a valid mainland China mobile number.
error.invalid_code: The code must be six digits and still valid.
error.sms_cooldown: Please wait at least 60 seconds before trying again. The server may impose a longer limit.
error.sms_failed: Could not send the SMS. Try later or sign in with a token.
error.login_failed: SMS login failed. Check the code, or sign in with a token.

abort.already_configured: This PetGravity home is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Use the same PetGravity account and home as the existing entry.
